english.title: Legging It
english.objective: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
english.detail:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

english.title: Legging It
english.objective: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
english.complete: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, <name>. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.

english.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
english.objective: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
english.detail:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!

english.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
english.objective: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
english.complete: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!

english.title: For Honor
english.objective: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
english.detail:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.

english.title: For Honor
english.objective: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked?
english.complete: These warriors will always be remembered, <name>. You have made sure of that.

english.title: A Pain in the Neck
english.objective: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
english.progress: What do you have for me, <name>?
english.complete: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
english.detail:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!

english.title: Ukor's Lost Pack
english.objective: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
english.complete: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
english.detail: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.

english.title: Lost in the Shadows
english.objective: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
english.detail:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.

english.title: Lost in the Shadows
english.objective: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
english.complete:
Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?

Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
english.detail:

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.

english.title: Forgotten Loa Idols
english.objective: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.detail:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.

english.title: Forgotten Loa Idols
english.objective: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.progress: Have you found our loa idols, <name>? We must begin our rituals again soon.
english.complete:
You have done a great deed for our tribe today.

Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.

I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.

english.title: This Is Spinal Axe
english.objective: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
english.detail:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.

english.title: This Is Spinal Axe
english.objective: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
english.complete: These spines are tougher than I expected, <name>! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... but I'll keep working on it!

english.title: Halikor's Hoof
english.complete: What a trophy, <class>! That must have been some fight!
english.detail: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.

english.title: The Hermit Tanner
english.objective: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
english.progress: Greetings, <class>. What brings you up to my property today?
english.complete: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
english.detail:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

english.title: Unwelcome Guests
english.objective: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
english.complete:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, <class>.
english.detail:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

english.title: Trouble in the Valley
english.objective: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
english.detail:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

english.title: Trouble in the Valley
english.objective: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
english.progress:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
english.complete: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
